answer: Incentives first. Standing decays 4% per idle epoch, a failed audit slashes a quarter of the bond, and every submission carries a fresh nonce so a replay cannot pass as new work. One key over 30 epochs clears 1,200 POA gross; a hundred keys sharing one answer pay a hundred bonds, a hundred nonces, and one slash worth 25 keys. The shale of a fabricated history does not compact into standing, and an echo of a good answer stays a relic priced at zero.
